title: beach scene shower curtain
text: beach scene shower curtain. I have glass shower doors in Arizona with HARD water.  I can't stand looking at them. Until I can remodel, I hung this very light weight, material shower curtain. Much more pleasing to look at when I am sitting in there... It also came with really light light shower curtain loops... perfect for my use because I don't actually use it as a "shower curtain."  You migh want some rings that are bit more sturdy if you are actually using it in a heavy duty way.  I did get my steamer out and steam our the folds.  It hangs quite nicely.  The photo is just as shown in the ad.  The colors are natural looking, not harsh or phony looking.  I never shy away from updating my reviews if new info would be helpful.
